ideas.pitch: A lightweight mobile-web application for rural local bodies to track community water assets, solar pump maintenance schedules, and welfare fund distribution transparently.
ideas.problem_statement: Real-time challenges faced by rural and urban communities in India under themes like Digital Empowerment and Sustainability
ideas.title: GramPanchayat Asset & Subsidy Tracker
ideas.why_it_could_win: Mirrors the success pattern of JalSetu by targeting rural governance pain points that judges from local development backgrounds immediately recognize and value.

ideas.pitch: A localized B2B marketplace connecting farmers who have crop residue (stubbles, husk) with local cardboard and biofuel manufacturers to prevent stubble burning.
ideas.problem_statement: Agriculture and Sustainability themes addressing real-time environmental challenges in India
ideas.title: KrishiKachra: Agricultural Waste Upcycling Exchange
ideas.why_it_could_win: Tackles a massive seasonal socio-environmental crisis in India with a clear marketplace model that provides quantifiable carbon offset metrics for judges.

ideas.pitch: A smartphone app that utilizes device accelerometer data and background computer vision to automatically detect road anomalies and potholes, mapping them directly to municipal repair dashboards.
ideas.problem_statement: Urban Solutions and Sustainability themes for real-time civic infrastructure management
ideas.title: PotholePatrol: Crowdsourced Road Safety Scanner
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages a working sensor-based demo that judges can test live on their own phones during presentation walk-throughs.

ideas.pitch: A computer vision web scanner integrated with local waste collection drives that identifies recyclable packaging via barcode or image upload and awards redeemable digital local coupons.
ideas.problem_statement: Sustainability and Urban Solutions themes focusing on neighborhood waste mismanagement
ideas.title: SwachhBin: Smart Segregation Incentivization System
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines gamification with an environmental cause, hitting the exact formula that won Best Hack for Social Good at Sunhacks.

ideas.pitch: A rapid SMS and web-app platform enabling rural and semi-urban gig workers (electricians, plumbers, masons) to build voice-verified digital portfolios and connect with urban employers.
ideas.problem_statement: Digital Empowerment and Student Innovation themes targeting economic mobility in India
ideas.title: SkillSetu: Hyper-Local Informal Labor Directory & Micro-Credentialing
ideas.why_it_could_win: Focuses on inclusive digital empowerment for unorganized sectors, aligning directly with national digital public infrastructure priorities.
